time_increment.description: "1" for daily rows, up to "90", "monthly" or "all_days" (default)

breakdowns.description: Breakdowns, e.g. [age, gender] or [publisher_platform] (only some combinations are allowed)

nodes.title: Change budget
nodes.description: Change the daily or lifetime budget of a campaign (campaign budget) or ad set, in the account currency's minor units. Agent tools also need META_ADS_TOOL_MAX_DAILY_BUDGET (as an agent tool only when META_ADS_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1)

daily_budget.description: Daily budget in the ad account currency's minor units (2000 = USD 20.00; JPY, IDR and similar have no minor unit: 50000 = IDR 50,000)

lifetime_budget.description: Lifetime budget in the account currency's minor units (needs end_time on ad sets)

object_type.description: What object_id is (required for agent tools: the account and budget are read before the change)
